stories.title: Freddie Slater's 'surreal' first taste of Formula 1
stories.summary: The rising star tells the BBC about his experience taking part in F1 practice in Mexico.

stories.title: Gold Elizabethan posy ring found in field
stories.summary: A detectorist found the inscripted ring which has a sale price of up to £3,000.

stories.title: Rugby is only council to put its whole art collection on display
stories.summary: More than 500,000 pieces of art are owned by 225 councils, the BBC finds, but most of it is storage.

stories.title: Victims 'frustrated' as abusive teacher spared more jail time
stories.summary: Paul Stainsby, who worked at Warwick School, has dementia and is already serving a 14-year sentence.

stories.title: Aldi consults over cutting 150 jobs at head office
stories.summary: The supermarket chain said the planned cuts were part of a restructuring of its UK operation.

stories.title: 'The town that never forgets' marks Armistice Day
stories.summary: The town has been hosting a parade and service since 1921.

stories.title: Questions over police chief recruitment after candidate dropped
stories.summary: Warwickshire's PCC withdraws the preferred candidate status from the chief constable named in June 2026.

stories.title: 'Police did not investigate bullet hitting my home'
stories.summary: A homeowner has accused Warwickshire Police of failing to investigate after his house was struck by a bullet.

stories.title: Woman avoids jail after man died in dog attack
stories.summary: June Miles, 78, denied perverting the course of justice after the death of a man in Solihull.

stories.title: Neighbours used ladders to rescue people from devastating fire
stories.summary: A man and a woman have been taken to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital for further treatment.

stories.title: Rare cancer discovered after mum underwent hysterectomy
stories.summary: Mum-of-four Donna Marklew, from Coventry, discovered she had cancer after a post-op biopsy.

stories.title: Warwickshire-born author wins Booker Prize for 'baffling but brilliant' novel
stories.summary: M John Harrison becomes the oldest ever winner of the prestigious literary award at the age of 81.
